title: Glowstone Dust Recipe
description: Adds a good and inexpensive vanilla recipe for glowstone dust
body:
# Tested for a few versions
**May work on other versions but I've haven't tested yet**

The recipe type is shapeless so you can put the ingredients in whatever order and placement you want

![torch+coal+redstone dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/938adebcecdbc59fa7180bd30a7f18aa313599c3.png)

**The recipe also works with any other type of coal (coal/charcoal) and torch (soul/copper/redstone torches)**

### **Tested versions (works)**
- 1.21.11
- 1.21.8
- 1.21.2
- 1.21
